topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I've been thinking a lot about my neighbor's request to install a fence. It's a reasonable ask, I understand that, and I've seen the plans. They're neat, respectful of the property lines. But the thing is, I worry about how it might change things between us. We've always had an open line of communication, an unspoken agreement about respecting each other's space without barriers. I remember the times we've shared laughs over the garden hose, or the kids playing ball across our yards. Maybe it's silly, but I can't help but feel like this fence might put up more than just a physical boundary. I'll talk to them, see if we can find a middle ground, something that keeps our connection as strong as it's always been.
